_note: Round 22 lane A (self-embedded read / roadmap X2). One entry for merge into liber-primus/LEDGER.json entries[]. Keys match the LEDGER.json entry schema. NEW lens: the search space is the DECRYPTED SOLVED PLAINTEXT, not the ciphertext or the number/value channel (Round 11 N1-N5/S1-S2 worked those). Trust anchor validate.py passed 5/5 before the run; Phase-0 positive control recovered a planted acrostic at power 1.000 before any real candidate was scored; seed 3301 order-preserving nulls.

entries.hypothesis: roadmap X2 read literally: the hidden message is a SELECTION (acrostic / every-k-th rune / diagonal fold read) OF THE ALREADY-SOLVED PLAINTEXT, not of the ciphertext -- 'discover the truth inside yourself / seek within' + 'test the knowledge' as an instruction to look inside the pages already decrypted. Enumerate the bounded selection-function set over the concatenated solved-page plaintext (5 rig-reproduced pages, 1887 letters / 1769 rune indices, book order) and test whether any selected string is more English/structured than the same selection applied to order-shuffled source, at a pre-registered FPR.
entries.threshold: Pre-registered in PREREG.md before any candidate was scored. Recognizer: src/lp/score.py score_norm (KJV-weighted English quadgram; ~-2.2 English, <-4 noise). SURVIVOR iff score_norm > the candidate's OWN size-matched null bar at FPR=0.001 (per selection LENGTH, 1000 order-shuffles of the source, seed 3301) AND it also clears the FAMILY-WISE bar = max score over the entire null across all lengths. No fixed score bar. Positive control (Phase 0) required recovery >= 1.0 of a planted acrostic before the real sweep was trusted (Q5 kill gate).
entries.control_detail: PHASE0-GATE.py planted a known English message at (a) every-7th and (b) width-13-diagonal positions inside an i.i.d. length-matched control (1887 letters, seed 3301, drawn from the solved-concat letter histogram) and ran the FULL sweep. Both plants RECOVERED as the top selection ranked by excess over their own size-matched null bar: every-k k=7 -> everyk_k7_o0 score -4.089 vs bar -6.177 (excess +2.088); diagonal w=13 -> everyk_k14_o0 (== diag_w13, a labeling identity: diag width w picks positions r*(w+1)) score -4.073 vs bar -6.178 (excess +2.105). Measured recovery/power = 2/2 = 1.000 -> GATE PASS. The instrument provably sees a self-embedded acrostic when one is present, so the real-data null is a genuine bound, not blind-recognizer silence.
entries.result: NULL. Across BOTH representations of the concatenated solved plaintext (letter stream 1887, greedy rune-index stream 1769), 0 of 1754 selection functions per representation (3508 total) cleared the family-wise bar. Family survivors: 0 / 0. Per-cell survivors at FPR=0.001: 4 (letters) + 2 (runes) = 6, versus 3.5 expected by chance over 3508 tests -- statistically indistinguishable from zero, each clearing its bar by a trivial margin (excess 0.01-0.21) and every one unreadable gibberish (best score -5.37/-5.25 vs real English ~-2.2). Language-agnostic secondary stats (IoC*N, min-distinct-32, base32 fraction, gzip ratio) show no structured outlier either. IMPLICATION: 'seek within / test the knowledge' as a self-embedded acrostic/every-k/diagonal read of the rig-solved pages is CLEAN NEGATIVE. Instrument finding: the width-w main diagonal == every-(w+1) at offset 0, so diagonals are subsumed by the every-k family.
entries.coverage: Selection-FUNCTION coverage (NOT key space; the transform is identity on already-decrypted runes, so the selection IS the swept axis). 3508 selection functions = 1754 per representation x 2 representations {letter stream, greedy rune-index stream}: every-k for k in [2,40] over all offsets o in [0,k-1] (~780) + reversed every-k (~780) + diagonal/anti-diagonal folds w in [2,60] (~118). Search space = the 5 solved pages validate.py reproduces (A WARNING, SOME WISDOM, two KOANs, WELCOME), concatenated in book order = 1887 letters / 1769 rune indices. Power = Phase-0 recovery 1.000 on planted acrostics of the same shape.
entries.evidence: analysis/round22/A-selfembedded-read/sweep_results.json (per-candidate score_norm + IoC*N + min_distinct_32 + base32_frac + gzip_ratio + own null bar + excess for all 3508 selections; family bars; survivor lists). RESULTS.md + PREREG.md + PHASE0-GATE.py alongside.

entries.reopens_if: A first-rune-of-each-PRINTED-LINE acrostic using the real page-image line geometry (not the concatenated transliteration this lane had) -- the sharpest reopener, needs P0.2/P0.3-style line-break transcription. OR a self-embedded read over the WIDER community-solved LP corpus (this repo trusts only the 5 rig-reproduced pages; AN END / parable material not in SOLVED-PAGES.json is unenumerated). OR keyword-cued / two-stage selections (every rune after a cue word). OR a non-English target register (Latin/Welsh prose) needing its own LM beyond the base32/IoC screen.
entries.notes: Doctrine R2: coverage x power reported together (3508 functions x recovery 1.000). Doctrine R3: language-agnostic stats persisted per candidate at run time. This is roadmap lens X2, NEVER run before -- distinct from Round 11 (N1-N5/S1-S2 worked the CIPHERTEXT number/value/separator channels; this works the DECRYPTED English plaintext). Red-team self-check: confirmed no silent re-read of a Round-11 lens. Doctrine R7: this is a BOUND over the enumerated selection set on the rig-solved 5 pages, not 'X2 closed'. Seal note (R21 L1) moot: no survivor to certify; had one cleared the bar it would be FLAGGED-FOR-ORACLE, not auto-certified.
entries.null: Per selection LENGTH: distribution of score_norm for a random contiguous slice of that length from 1000 order-shuffles of the source symbols (histogram-preserving, destroys order, seed 3301). FPR=0.001 -> 99.9th percentile as the per-cell bar. Family-wise bar = max over all null draws across all lengths. Controls for 'English letters leak through any selection of English text' -- a selection must beat what the SAME selection yields on shuffled solved-plaintext.
entries.not_covered: Printed-line/word acrostics using true page-image line-break + word-spacing geometry (only the concatenated transliteration was available; physical layout unreconstructed). The wider community-solved LP corpus beyond the 5 rig-reproduced pages. Keyword-cued and two-stage/recursive selections. Every-k for k>40 and fold widths w>60. Non-English target registers beyond the base32/IoC/gzip secondary screen. The /dev/urandom pad branch (a selection-of-plaintext null says nothing about it).
